import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_7/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_7/training_1.csv"

source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source2_7_0 and Source2_7_1 on "calaccess_committee_id"
joined = pd.merge(
    source0,
    source1,
    how="inner",
    on="calaccess_committee_id",
    suffixes=('_0', '_1')
)

# Operation 2: GROUP BY Source2_7_1.contributor_firstname, Source2_7_1.contributor_lastname
# and aggregate sum of Source2_7_1.amount

# Note: contributor_firstname and contributor_lastname come from source1 (joined columns with suffix _1)
grouped = (
    joined
    .groupby(['contributor_firstname', 'contributor_lastname'], as_index=False)
    .agg({'amount': 'sum'})
)

# Ensure the target schema and types:
# ['contributor_firstname': string, 'contributor_lastname': string, 'amount': float]

# Convert contributor_firstname and contributor_lastname to string explicitly
grouped['contributor_firstname'] = grouped['contributor_firstname'].astype(str)
grouped['contributor_lastname'] = grouped['contributor_lastname'].astype(str)
# amount should already be float from sum aggregation, but enforce float type
grouped['amount'] = grouped['amount'].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_7/target_multisource.csv"
grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_7/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_7/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source2_7_0 and Source2_7_1 on calaccess_committee_id (inner join)
joined = pd.merge(
    source0,
    source1,
    how="inner",
    left_on="calaccess_committee_id",
    right_on="calaccess_committee_id",
    suffixes=("", "_r")
)

# Group by contributor_firstname and contributor_lastname, sum the amount
result = joined.groupby(
    ["contributor_firstname", "contributor_lastname"], dropna=False, as_index=False
).agg({"amount": "sum"})

# Write output with exact target schema column names
result.to_csv(
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_7/target_multisource_critique_history.csv",
    index=False,
)
